editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: This edition prints four stanzas (it omits Bliss's familiar "Guilty, vile, and helpless we" stanza). Each printed music line holding two 7-syllable lines was split by rhyme into four lines per stanza; musical hyphens, the sung Amen, and the 1917 John Church Co. music copyright line were omitted.
